name: ENRTF Community Grant Program: Community Impact Funding Round
summary: Minnesota ENRTF community grants for nonprofit, Tribal and local-government projects that protect or enhance natural resources or manage aquatic invasive species. The same round also has trail and education areas, which are outside this site's scope.

calls.label: FY2027 Community Impact Funding Round

status.quote: The application system is not open during the November preparation period. The DNR will provide the application access link when Stage 1 opens on December 1.

opens.quote: December 1, 2026: Stage 1 Concept Note application opens in Foundant. January 7, 2027, at 11:59 p.m. Central: Stage 1 Concept Note deadline.

deadline.quote: December 1, 2026: Stage 1 Concept Note application opens in Foundant. January 7, 2027, at 11:59 p.m. Central: Stage 1 Concept Note deadline.

calls.note: Trail maintenance and education/awareness areas are out of scope; use the natural resources or aquatic invasive species areas.

pool.quote: Approximately $4 million is available for grants of $20,000 to $150,000. No matching funds are required.

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include nonprofit organizations, Tribal Nations and Tribal governmental entities, local and regional governmental entities and other recipients permitted under the governing Community Grant Program authority.

geography.quote: The Community Grant Program supports organizations and communities working to protect, conserve, preserve or enhance Minnesota's environment and natural resources.

access.quote: The application has two stages. All applicants begin with a shorter Stage 1 Concept Note. Only applicants invited to Stage 2 complete a full application.

window.quote: The application has two stages. All applicants begin with a shorter Stage 1 Concept Note. Only applicants invited to Stage 2 complete a full application.
